cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, base64
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import kit, encode

types = [
  {"name":"Bool","kind":"bool"},
  {"name":"Nib","kind":"int","bits":4},
  {"name":"E","kind":"enum","values":["a","b"]},
  {"name":"Ch","kind":"char"},
]
modules=[{"name":"m","params":[["b","Bool"],["n","Nib"],["e","E"],["c","Ch"]],
          "result":["r","Bool"],"requires":None}]
base={"types":types,"modules":modules,"calls":[],"pipes":[],"entries":["m"],"machine":None,"runs":[]}
plan=kit.run(base)["plans"][0]
print(json.dumps(plan))
m=modules[0]
good,n=encode.build(types,m,{"b":True,"n":5,"e":"b","c":"Z"},False)
print(good,n)
def enc(objs,**kw): return kit.encode(objs,**kw)
cases={
 "good": enc(good),
 "bad-magic": enc(good,magic=b'KTESX'),
 "version2": enc(good,version=2),
 "trailing": enc(good,trailing=b'\x00'),
 "missing": enc(good[:-1]),
 "extra-composite": enc(good+[('x5',b'\x00')]),   # x5 is the result bool... check numbering
 "duplicate": enc(good+[('x0',b'\x01')]),
 "bad-width": enc([(nm, d if nm!='x0' else b'\x00\x00') for nm,d in good]),
 "bad-name-lead0": enc([('x00',d) if nm=='x0' else (nm,d) for nm,d in good]),
 "bad-name-y": enc([('y0',d) if nm=='x0' else (nm,d) for nm,d in good]),
 "bool-2": enc([(nm, b'\x02' if nm=='x0' else d) for nm,d in good]),
 "nib-16": enc([(nm, b'\x10' if nm=='x1' else d) for nm,d in good]),
 "enum-2": enc([(nm, b'\x02\x00\x00\x00' if nm=='x2' else d) for nm,d in good]),
 "bad-b64": "!!!!not base64!!!!",
 "b64-whitespace": enc(good)[:4]+" "+enc(good)[4:],
 "args-65": enc(good,args=[b'a']*65),
 "arg-big": enc(good,args=[b'a']*257),
 "args-ok": enc(good,args=[b'a']*64+[b'']),
 "sym-ignored": enc(good,symbolic=(12345,6789)),
 "empty": "",
}
base["runs"]=[{"entry":"m","ktest":v} for v in cases.values()]
out=kit.run(base)
for k,r in zip(cases,out["records"]): print("%-16s %s" % (k, json.dumps(r)))
print(json.dumps(out["corpus"]))
PYEOF
